notes.title: Patch Notes for May 18th, 2025
notes.content:
1. Rewritten rendering with OpenGL. Now scales to any screen size with no borders.

2. All tables now have full screen and scrolling mode working correctly. F2 cycles between the two rendering modes.

3. Bug fixes to various tables. This corrects all known mission bugs.

4. Darkside and mutation looping music fixed.

5. Huge performance optimization, now runs much better at higher resolutions or on slower hardware.

notes.title: Patch Notes for February 5th, 2024
notes.content:
Hello, Ballers! We've listened to your feedback, and have made adjustments to the gamepad controls for Balls of Steel. Now, you can use your controller's Left and Right Triggers or bumpers to activate the flippers. Just update the game to the latest version to try it out.

[b]Full Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Adjusted controller configs for all tables
[*]Added new splash screen art on launch
[/list]
